title: Unit 4 - What are you doing now?

parts.title: Listening Part 1
parts.instructions: For each question, choose the correct answer.

items.question: How much was Jenny's new tennis racket?
What time does the hockey match start?
What is the boy drinking?
options: A hot drink in a mug

items.question: Who is the girl's table tennis coach?

script.speaker: Man
script.text: How much was Jenny's new tennis racket?

script.speaker: Woman
script.text: Well, she wanted one that cost forty-five pounds, but she found <u>one for thirty-five pounds</u> that was just as good.

script.speaker: Man
script.text: What time does the hockey match start?

script.speaker: Woman
script.text: It was going to start at four twenty, but they've changed it. <u>It now starts at four thirty</u>.

script.speaker: Boy
script.text: I was going to have some lemonade, but then I saw <u>the orange juice</u>. I'll have the hot chocolate later.

script.speaker: Man
script.text: Who is the girl's table tennis coach?

script.speaker: Girl
script.text: My coach hasn't got blonde hair, and <u>he wears glasses</u>. He's really good!
